title: Profile Extensions
description: Five independent studies that expand athlete-profile communication to adjacent surfaces such as coach cards, milestone tiles, and comparisons.
creative_direction: Independent rollout studies for Athlete Spotlight and Profile Card Family. These images explore adjacent portrait-and-stats use cases while keeping the visual language grounded in real team media, recruitment decks, and campaign cards.
